scene:
The picture has three parts read left to right, separated by thin vertical navy lines. The parts have no headings. All text is horizontal.

On the left third, a chain drawn as a top-to-bottom column of four large round nodes joined by thick metal chain links, with a downward reading order. Top node: a gear icon, label SETUP STEP. Second node: an hourglass with less sand, label LESS EFFORT. Third node: a group of three small customer figures, label CUSTOMERS SERVED. Bottom node: a stack of plain blank coins with no symbols, label CASH. The chain between SETUP STEP and LESS EFFORT is whole, with a small teal check mark beside it. The chain between LESS EFFORT and CUSTOMERS SERVED is visibly snapped open, with an ochre gap and the label LINK BROKEN beside it. The last link to CASH is drawn as a faint dashed line.

In the middle third, a simple bar chart with no axes numbers: a tall navy-outlined bar labelled 80 HOURS BEFORE, and a shorter teal bar labelled 62 HOURS MEASURED; a horizontal dashed ochre line crosses lower than the teal bar, labelled 50 HOURS TARGET. Below the chart, an hourglass beside a closed piggy bank without symbols, with a navy arrow from the hourglass to the piggy bank crossed by an ochre stroke; under them the label CAPACITY, NOT CASH.

On the right third, a path with two gates. First, a small workbench with a magnifying glass over a data sheet, label DATA CHECK FUNDED. A navy arrow leads RIGHT/DOWN to a closed garden gate labelled MONTH 6, fastened by two padlocks side by side. Directly below the gate, two wide flat horizontal signs sit side by side, upright and level, not tilted: the left sign reads ≤ 50 HOURS and the right sign reads ≤ 8 WEEKS, with a clear less-than-or-equal symbol.

TEXT: draw exactly these labels, each once and nothing else: SETUP STEP, LESS EFFORT, CUSTOMERS SERVED, CASH, LINK BROKEN, 80 HOURS BEFORE, 62 HOURS MEASURED, 50 HOURS TARGET, CAPACITY, NOT CASH, DATA CHECK FUNDED, MONTH 6, ≤ 50 HOURS, ≤ 8 WEEKS. Icons, coins and sheets carry no lettering, numbers or symbols of their own. Any other text is a defect.
alt: A chain runs from the setup step to less effort, which holds, then snaps before customers served, with a faint link on to cash; bars show 80 hours before and 62 hours measured against a 50-hour target, and freed time is capacity, not cash; a data check is funded, and a month-six gate is locked by two tests, 50 hours or less and eight weeks or less.
caption: The chain from setup step to cash, where it held and where it broke; the measured hours against the target; and the two tests the next stage must pass.
